visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a light blue shirt and a white baseball cap is seen being pushed and encouraged from behind by friends toward a street performer's setup. She has a young boy clinging to her waist. The setting is a bright, busy urban walkway at night with numerous storefronts and passers-by visible in the background. The lighting is warm and artificial, reflecting off the paved ground. (2) The woman stands in front of a microphone stand next to another female performer in a white off-shoulder top and a male guitarist wearing a black bucket hat. She holds a microphone and sings with a shy expression, occasionally looking at a tablet on a stand for lyrics. Her son remains close, leaning his head against her. The camera uses a medium shot to capture the trio performing, showing their facial expressions and hand movements. (3) After the performance, the woman smiles broadly and bows slightly to the crowd. She then grabs her son's hand and they both turn away from the performers, laughing and jogging quickly into the crowd of the urban night scene. The camera follows her movement as she moves away from the brightly lit performance area into the dimmer parts of the street.
